title: Expansion admission protocol
description: Objective: implement bounded expansion request, quality assessment, all-or-none refusal, exact budget preparation, and graph-level approval. Deliverable: core/scheduler expansion modules and race tests. NOT in scope: automatic approval or partial child activation. Hard dependencies: Anti-blocking admission, Fair scheduler production, Policy approval core, and Conserved budget core. Owned paths: packages/core/src/expansion/** and packages/scheduler/src/expansion/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core test && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Expansion is refused unless all quality, scope, budget, capacity, and dependency preconditions pass.
Approval binds exact proposed revision and prepared resources; a changed delta requires reapproval.
No child obtains authority from a partially admitted expansion.
Focused core and scheduler tests pass.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.
